tips.text: Fill the daily standing cap every day; it is the only thing slowing this grind.
Do Suda's three daily Syndicate Alerts first, play until capped, then turn in the medallions; they ignore the cap.
Turn in Universal Syndicate Medallions from Disruption rewards; each is 1,000 standing and ignores the cap.
Rotate the pledge between Suda and Steel Meridian to get both to Rank 5 without losses.
Rank up the moment the bar fills; Red Veil and New Loka keep draining while it sits full.
Farm affinity-heavy content like Sanctuary Onslaught; fast kills fill the cap fast.
Ignore old advice about swapping sigils; pledging replaced it.
Players call Suda a daily-cap chore, not a hard farm.
